notes.title: Major Sale 65% OFF - Puzzle & Lighting Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Santa's Shadow Second Major Update[/h1]

Hello everyone!

Santa's Shadow is on sale, at 65% off, from March 24th until March 31st.

Major Changes included in Update 1.2: 

Players can now explore the mansion in a whole new lighting. Utilizing lumen and Unreal Engine 5's vast array of lighting systems, the atmosphere of Santa's Shadow has completely changed!

Many puzzles around the house now have corresponing hints scattered about. This will help the player take notice of the different options in the mansion.

[h2]Santa's Shadow DirectX11[/h2]

Santa's Shadow was originally made with DirectX 12 in mind. I believe offering support for DirectX 11 directly will help users who have had trouble running the game due to the power DirectX 12/Unreal Engine 5 requires. 

When launching the game you will be prompted with two launch options. The default will run DirectX12.

Pick the second option for DirectX 11. You can also check 'Always use this option' to stop the launch options from coming up every time.

This update gives an option for lower end users to choose which rendering hardware interface (RHI) they prefer.

Thank you for reading! 

As always:

[b]Below is a google forms link where any bugs can be submitted and addressed![/b]

I encourage anyone who has had issues to submit a form!

[url=https://forms.gle/Y74F8BN9gSrfDYCB9]Santa's Shadow Google Forms Bug Reports[/url]

notes.title: First Major Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Santa's Shadow First Major Update[/h1]

Major Changes included in Update 1.1: 

[b]1. Implemented Practice Mode.[/b]

[Players can now explore the mansion without threats. Utilize practice mode to test puzzles, item mechanics, and optimize your strategy!]

[b]2. Flashlight Base Battery life updated.[/b]

[The flashlight battery now lasts 10 minutes per battery. (For reference it was originally 3 minutes.) This will help new players have more time exploring before being pressured to find other resources.]

[b]3. Added Restart Level Button.[/b]

[Players can now restart the level at any moment. This will allow players to quickly get back into the game after running low on resources.]

[b]5. Subtitle UI Change. [/b]

[The original subtitle size had a hard time getting player attention. The size is now larger and more noticeable for all types of players.]

[b]6. Proportional resources based on difficulty.[/b]

[Resources are now less common in hard mode.]

[b]7. Main Menu / Pause Menu UI Changes.[/b]

[The main menu / pause menu now have a larger font size, which is more visible.]

[b]8. Settings Menu Bug Fix.[/b]

[Fixed a bug where settings for 'High' and 'Lumen' would not always save correctly.]

[b]9. Smaller changes.[/b]

[Other tutorial items and general patches, which make the game flow better have also been added.]

Thank you for reading my update notes. I am actively making changes that players want. Please feel free to access the Bug Report form below to suggest further changes!

[h1]Below is a google forms link where any bugs can be submitted and addressed![/h1]

I encourage anyone who has had issues to submit a form!

[url=https://forms.gle/Y74F8BN9gSrfDYCB9]Santa's Shadow Google Forms Bug Reports[/url]
